raw.title: Updates openapi json schema generator
raw.body:
Updates openapi json schema generator
which now support openapi 3.1.0 per https://github.com/openapi-json-schema-tools/openapi-json-schema-generator/releases/tag/3.1.0

1. tools.yaml updated to show `v3_1: true` for openapi json schema generator
2. ran `yarn run build:all`

If merged, this will close out https://github.com/OAI/Tooling/issues/96
